shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: Trading away my only A to get a 2nd B would leave me with 0 A, 1 C, 2 B — reducing variety and not improving utility since I value diversity. Current balanced holding (1,1,1) is already optimal; this trade unbalances it.

Trading 1B for 1A would just swap my inventory from (1,1,1) to (2,1,0), creating imbalance and lowering variety value. Since I already have equal amounts of all three goods, this trade doesn't improve my utility.
This would leave me with 0 B, destroying variety and overloading on A, which reduces my overall utility despite the 2-for-1 ratio.
Trading away C for B would just swap which good I have 2 of versus 0, giving no net variety gain (I'd go from 1,1,1 to 1,0,2), which is worse since now I have zero of C instead of a balanced set.
Trading away my only B to get a second C would reduce variety (ending with 2C,1A,0B instead of balanced 1-1-1), lowering my utility since I value diversity across goods.
Giving up my only B to get more C would hurt variety—leaving me with zero B while stacking C. I'd rather keep a balanced inventory.
This trade would leave me with 0 A, 2 B, 1 C, reducing variety and giving me an unbalanced bundle. Since I value variety, trading away my only A for a second B doesn't improve my utility.
This trade would give me 2×A and 0×B, reducing variety instead of increasing it. Since I value variety, going from 1-1-1 to 2-1-0 decreases my utility rather than improving it.
Giving up my only B to get more A would leave me with none of B, hurting variety; I'd rather keep a balanced bundle or negotiate a smaller trade.
Trading 1C for 1B would leave me with 2B and 0C, reducing variety (1,1,1 -> 1,0,2). Since I value variety, this swap doesn't improve my utility; it just shifts imbalance rather than resolving it.

This would leave me with 2×C and 0×B, reducing variety from an even 1-1-1 split to an unbalanced bundle. Since I value variety, trading away my only B for a second C decreases my utility rather than increasing it.

Giving away my only A would leave me with zero of that good, hurting variety even though B would increase. Better to keep at least 1 A.
